No, express isn't available for this order. A 5 ft ficus counts as an XL plant (usually over 4 ft), which ships Standard only. Alaska also falls under Zone 3 (remote addresses), where Express isn't offered.

Your cost would be the **$20 XL handling fee** plus **Standard shipping of $7.95**. Standard shipping is free if your order is $75 or more after discounts and before tax. The policy doesn't say the handling fee is waived, so expect it either way. Standard delivery to Zone 3 takes 5-8 business days.

Live plants ship Monday to Wednesday only. If the transit forecast is below 35°F or above 95°F, your plant may be held for up to 7 days, and you'll be emailed about it.
